annotations.title: Hyperliquid whale tracker: the large accounts, long vs short, positions, changes

description: Call this when the user asks what Hyperliquid whales are doing, whether the biggest Hyperliquid accounts are net long or short a coin, for the largest open positions with liquidation prices, or what large accounts just opened, closed or flipped. Returns the live board of Hyperliquid's large accounts (every account whose open perpetual positions add up to a large sum, found in the venue's public fill record, together with the largest accounts by equity on its public leaderboard; positions are read on the main dex and on the builder-deployed dexes (markets such as xyz:NVDA), the largest accounts every 5 minutes, the others every 20 to 25 minutes (measured on 24 November 2026; the venue's request limit sets the pace); an account that trades a net $1,000,000 of a single coin between two readings is read at once; addresses only) and with events the last 200 position changes. Without coin, the 30 largest coins and positions; pass coin, or limit (up to 200) for more. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

coin.description: One coin as Hyperliquid names it, e.g. BTC, kPEPE, xyz:NVDA (a builder-deployed market carries its dex in front; any case)

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

events.description: Include the last 200 position change events

limit.description: Optional. Coins and positions without coin, largest first (default 30).
